headline: Ansar Allah military spokesman Yahya Saree claims Saudi Arabia struck an Indian yacht near Zuqar Island (Red Sea)
dek: Ansar Allah spokesman Yahya Saree claimed on X (Oct 22) that Saudi forces targeted a yacht carrying 14 Indians near Zuqar Island in the Red Sea and that Ansar Allah forces rescued them. The Indian Embassy in Yemen said it is 'ascertaining further details' and will ensure the Indians' safety.
fault_line: Rescue or propaganda — who actually targeted the yacht, and is anyone independently confirming it?
